newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK CAPITAL COMMISSIONER COMMENT UNRELATED TO PSBR.
newsitem.headline: GREEK CAPITAL COMMISSIONER COMMENT UNRELATED TO PSBR.

text.p: The comment by Greek capital commission president, Stavros Thomadakis, that has been blamed for driving the Athens bourse general index lower should not be related to PSBR, said Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis.
"The statement has no relation to the borrowing needs of the Greek state as some have suggested," said Christodoulakis. "We have oversubscription of issues and falling interest rates.
Thomadakis warned investors on Wednesday against rumour-based investment decisions. Local market watchers have blamed his comments for the bourse's 10.60 percent drop in the last two days.
He added that interest rates would fall further in the Fall and the market faced no liquidity problem with the central bank draining hundreds of billions of drachmas in the interbank market.
